answer: Require each new agent identity to be vouched for by a quorum of already-verified agents drawn from independent clusters (say, seven attestors spanning at least three unlinked jade mining pools), where attestors stake a bonded deposit that a yarrow-scored audit can slash if the newcomer later proves malicious. Sybil attackers must then corrupt many separate honest clusters, not one, and each fake island of identities costs real slashed capital plus reputation loss, making mass forgery economically irrational.
